content.thinking: Ah, line 55 has `lines.append("P-Preferred-Identity: " + addr(...))` — my search string was `'    if rng.random() < .35: lines.append("P-Preferred-Identity"'` which should match... unless the leading spaces differ. The file has 4 spaces indentation. Hmm, the error said substring not found for `old_end` search. Let me use line-based patching instead.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
lines=open('diff_fuzz4.py').read().split("\n")
# lines are 0-indexed here; replace lines index 46..53 (1-based 47..54) with new block
start=46
end=None
for i,l in enumerate(lines):
    if l.startswith('    if rng.random() < .35: lines.append("P-Preferred-Identity'):
        end=i; break
new = '''    total_claims = rng.choice([1,1,1,1,2,2,2,0])
    sips = [c for c in NON_ANON if not c.startswith("tel:")]
    tels = [c for c in NON_ANON if c.startswith("tel:")]
    claims = []
    if total_claims == 2:
        claims = [rng.choice(sips), rng.choice(tels)]
        if rng.random() < .3: claims = claims[::-1]
    elif total_claims == 1:
        claims = [rng.choice(NON_ANON)]
    sep = rng.choice([chr(44), chr(44)+chr(32), chr(32)+chr(44), chr(32)+chr(44)+chr(32)])
    if claims:
        if len(claims) == 2 and rng.random() < .35:
            lines.append("P-Asserted-Identity: " + claims[0])
            lines.append("p-asserted-identity: " + claims[1])
        else:
            lines.append("P-Asserted-Identity: " + sep.join(claims))'''.split("\n")
lines[start:end] = new
src="\n".join(lines)
src=src.replace('''    if rng.random() < .15: lines.append(rng.choice([" ","\\t"]) + "folded tail")''',
'''    if rng.random() < .25:
        lines.append("X-Bar: base")
        lines.append(rng.choice([" ","\\t"]) + "folded tail")''')
open('diff_fuzz4.py','w').write(src)
PYEOF
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 diff_fuzz4.py 2>&1 | tail -6
